title: SCTA vs an independent build of the temporal-aggregation design, solved by cvxpy/CLARABEL
paper: Sun, Ben-Michael & Feller (2024), 'Temporal Aggregation for the Synthetic Control Method', AEA P&P 114: 614-617
reference_impl: independent implementation of Sun, Ben-Michael & Feller (2024) Sec. 2 stacked design, solved by cvxpy/CLARABEL
note: The reference lives in the case module itself: the paper's four-step recipe rebuilt from the equations, with no import from mlsynth.utils.scta_helpers, and solved by an interior-point conic solver where mlsynth uses a primal active-set QP. The panel is the ibex monthly day-ahead electricity price with Spain treated in June 2022, not the paper's Texas SB8 live-birth panel, which is not redistributable here; docs/replications/scta.rst records what each of the two checks covers.
